name: 3W real-event detector
limitations: Bounded real-file subset, not the full 3W benchmark.
Not a GRU; random forest baseline uses causal sensor windows.
Missing sensors withhold prediction. Native 3W sensor conventions only.
No field latency, false alarms/day or early-warning qualification.
Measured classification scores do not establish probability calibration.
runtime_note: Measured on development computer; not edge-device benchmark
decision: Rejected: held-out macro F1 below baseline. Metrics/predictions retained, fitted binary removed.
